description: Verifies raw.browser.getBrowserCommandLine by issuing raw CDP command(s) Browser.getBrowserCommandLine against an about:blank page. It passes when every non-optional CDP step completes without a protocol error. Optional steps are best-effort, and returned values are not graded. The Browser-domain command is sent over the page-target transport. This probe is diagnostic-only because the benchmark launch profile does not declare `--enable-automation`.
title: raw.browser.getBrowserCommandLine
